nodes.hypothesis: Select fresh molecular graph edits with a single epsilon-greedy continuation-value network, advance persistent finite-horizon episodes through every matched accepted successor, and learn from accepted transitions using undiscounted episode-best improvement rewards and double-Q Bellman backups through a lagged target network.
nodes.finding:
One screening seed, macro mean 0.406692671573943, eighth among the campaign's thirteen Discovery roots on a spread running 0.2331 to 0.5103. Per objective the means were 0.7536466193285815 on the docking task, 0.6145349727054742 on the decoration-hop task, 0.33218372414937963 on the zaleplon task, 0.19512536527753646 on the median task and 0.13797267640874414 on the sitagliptin task. Every registered observable moved as intended. The graph sampler filled all 1450 acting neighbourhoods with 40 valid novel candidates each and all 20215 replay continuation neighbourhoods with eight, emitting exactly 29 batches of ten unique molecules per objective with zero invalid, duplicate or rejected proposals; an independent re-execution of 17026 distinct edit receipts reproduced every one. The temporal machinery worked: 250 episode starts, 1200 multistep continuations, and 800 accepted transitions that strictly lowered the score yet still advanced their lane, of which 666 went on to be the source of a later edit. Reward telescoping held to a maximum residual of 5.551115123125783e-17 with gamma exactly one. Of 22900 replay targets, 2685 were horizon terminals equal to reward and all 20215 nonterminal continuation terms were nonzero, mean 0.013847408184662015, so the targets genuinely differed from reward-only regression. Learning registered: mean paired Huber loss fell from 6.10635587187527e-05 to 5.3964929417511364e-05 and mean absolute temporal-difference error from 0.004401601105964189 to 0.004148056249060887, decreasing on every objective, with 1242 of 1450 individual steps improving. The learned values then drove behaviour: 1095 exploitation choices against 355 random ones, every neighbourhood showing nonconstant values, and a fixed sixteen-candidate diagnostic probe changing its preferred molecule 30 times over training. The counterweight is the sparsity of signal: 1179 of 1450 accepted transitions carried zero reward, only 271 were positive, and 2880 of the sampled continuations were predicted negative even though a true remaining episode-best gain can never be below zero.

The campaign now has a clean answer to a question it could not previously separate: correct temporal-credit machinery is not by itself worth a score. Every part of the Bellman construction was audited and held, including the exact double-Q target, the detached lagged network, reward telescoping, and the use of updated weights in subsequent decisions, and the result still lands in the lower half of the roots and below the frozen-latent swarm root that carries no learning at all. Two mechanisms explain that. The learning signal is thin, because four fifths of transitions carry zero reward under a running-best definition, so most gradient comes from the zero mass and the mean continuation term of 0.014 sits at the same scale as the residual error the network still has, which is also why nearly three thousand continuation values came out negative when the true quantity cannot be. And the search collapses: the molecules produced show that exploitation, once it finds a good core, spends its remaining budget swapping single atoms on that core, which is precisely the behaviour a value function would need a long-horizon reason to escape. For method choice this argues that direct graph editing is the right way to stay in makeable chemistry, but that pairing it with a value-learning controller adds machinery whose payoff is not visible at this feedback scale; the effort is better spent on the exploration and diversity side than on the credit-assignment side. Still open: this is a single seed with no parent and no paired comparison, so the ranking is indicative; the 216 recovered-loss links and 123 later episode-best gains after temporary losses are descriptive and do not isolate learned lookahead from ordinary hill-climbing; and whether episode-consistent randomised exploration would change the picture was deliberately left untested here.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove the direct formula-preserving aromatic C/N positional-exchange options from the inherited atom-replacement menu, leaving only its original single-atom element substitutions while retaining all other graph, feedback and posterior mechanisms.
nodes.finding:
All fifteen task runs completed. Final Top-1 macro mean was 0.595670, with seed population SD 0.026593; the three seed macros were 0.625412, 0.560866 and 0.600731. Every endpoint and every molecular trajectory reproduced the historical Anchor. Direct exchanges remained absent despite 904 eligible selected-site menus with 1,276 withheld partners. Accepted-only learning, crossover and correlated posterior selection all executed. The 4,350 accepted offspring produced 629 best-parent beats, 258 incumbent improvements and 2,401 later-used breeding molecules, exactly as before. The historical seeds are all profile-mismatched, so the protocol provides no paired effect estimate.

The campaign now has a complete baseline under the opening Research in Depth profile, with the exchange-free implementation and its feedback chain verified. Repeating the same seeds reproduced the same search histories; this adds execution and profile-baseline evidence without adding independent search trajectories or isolating any retained component’s value. The earlier finding that removing direct exchanges improved the mean remains a historical counterexample to the predicted loss, and is not retested here. The chemistry also reproduces the earlier limits: useful aromatic/carbonyl and aryl-amine arrangements coexist with reactive heteroatom–halogen bonds, doubtful ring geometry and unspecified stereochemistry. Those liabilities and uneven task dispersion persist at the reproduced score. Current-profile component interventions are still needed to determine which retained mechanisms support that score and whether useful chemistry can be preserved while improving reliability.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove inverse-prior-fitting-count weighting within the selected historical replay group, using the plain mean of squared individually ceiling-projected target residuals over the unchanged selected current and historical sequences while preserving their membership and total current/history shares.
nodes.finding:
The removal reached real learning in every eligible opportunity. Of 420 historical updates followed by proposals, 405 had unequal fitting counts; all 405 changed the combined gradient direction after clipping. The effective number of historical rows increased from 4.189 under the passive inverse-exposure comparator to exactly 5 on the same selected records. Historical coefficient-weighted earlier use increased from 3.553 to 4.768. All 450 first backward passes matched the actual equal-row objective exactly, and every update moved the policy parameters. The fifteen initialization updates and fifteen equal-count historical updates remained exact local controls.

All fifteen sessions completed. Mean final Top-1 fell from 0.522705 to 0.513278, a paired decline of 0.009427, exceeding the registered non-inferiority margin of 0.002. Seed changes were +0.005127, +0.005347 and -0.038755. Task means changed by -0.030197 for zaleplon, +0.003394 for deco-hop, -0.000972 for docking, -0.006338 for median and -0.013022 for sitagliptin. Mean recorded AUC increased from 0.405593 to 0.426905, showing better progress earlier in the budget despite the worse endpoint.

Raw duplicate draws increased from 32.21% to 35.83%, and batches requiring extra sampling increased from 16 to 18. Distinct observed molecular scaffolds decreased on every task. Equal-row projected fitting error on the child’s actual historical-update states fell from 29.885 to 3.503 during learning, while 845 of 2,100 historical row appearances worsened individually. Successful fitting and broader coefficient support therefore did not establish endpoint utility.

Individual target ceilings did not make exposure weighting dispensable on this panel. The paired controls narrow the change to its intended intervention: loaded priors matched, the first thirty accepted records matched in all fifteen sessions, and proposals diverged only after the first unequal-count update. Two seeds improved modestly, so the evidence supports a useful aggregate endpoint contribution from the removed rule under this composition, with substantial variation across seeds. It does not establish a universal benefit.

A larger effective number of weighted rows is not the same as broader molecular exploration. Giving repeatedly fitted records more influence coincided with more duplicate draws, fewer observed scaffolds and stronger concentration in some analogue families. The molecular assessment still finds rich aromatic and cyclic-amine chemistry, with uneven attachment and size control and no assigned stereochemistry; those limitations persisted despite even replay influence. This is compatible with redundant concentration, but the records do not isolate a particular remembered molecule or chemical feature as the cause.

The retained ceilings also leave a coupled feasibility problem: 235 of 420 prospective historical updates had projected target probability mass above one, and 42 set all ten selected targets to zero. Equal coefficients cannot recover distinctions erased by those ceilings. Fewer historical residual regressions than the parent’s 905 coexisted with a worse endpoint, ruling out that count as a sufficient utility measure. Passive gradient comparisons identify the local learning intervention; they supply no alternative Adam trajectory or alternative molecules. The remaining question is how the altered exploitation pattern produces better early progress but a large endpoint loss in one seed.

nodes.hypothesis: Within each inherited score quantile, sample accepted breeding parents with probability inversely proportional to the number of eligible survivors sharing their Murcko core, so every represented core has equal conditional mass.
nodes.finding:
The allocation change executed correctly in all three replicas. Of 111,246 parent draws, 86,634 had unequal core multiplicities; every logged probability vector and inverse-CDF choice matched the intended rule. On the same eligible states and logged uniform variates, 36,398 selected parent ranks and 29,554 selected cores differed from the passive uniform comparator. Mean represented cores used per breeding batch rose from 12.98 to 14.60, and mean concentration of breeding uses fell from 0.299 to 0.189, measured as the sum of squared core-use shares. Coverage rose in 10 of 15 task/seed sessions; the effect was not universal. All accepted-state, survivor and pending-provenance checks passed, and both panels completed all 4,500 oracle evaluations.

Strict best-parent beats increased from 565/4,350 (12.99%) to 600/4,350 (13.79%), and mean child-minus-best-parent score improved from -0.100493 to -0.093989. Incumbent improvements were nearly unchanged, at 216 versus 218. Mean final-best score across tasks and seeds fell from 0.544374 to 0.524118, a paired change of -0.020256. Seed changes were -0.052822, -0.023812 and +0.015865; all five task means declined. Thus the intended allocation mechanism is confirmed, while the intended score increase was not observed.

Equalizing core probability can reduce repeated use of abundant families without improving the best molecules found. The clearest coverage expansions were in decoration hopping and DRD2, yet their parent-beating counts and final-score means fell. Zaleplon breeding became more concentrated despite correct balancing within each selected band, showing that changing the conditional draw does not guarantee broader realized coverage once the evolving survivor population is considered.

The modest parent-beating gain also uses a weaker reference: mean best-generating-parent score fell from 0.419645 to 0.395720, while mean evaluated-offspring score fell from 0.319152 to 0.301731. This relative yield gain therefore does not establish stronger offspring production. The number of admitted offspring later reused for breeding stayed almost unchanged, at 2,163 versus 2,167, and incumbent gains did not increase. The evidence narrows the problem to allocating toward productive surviving families rather than simply reducing their multiplicity imbalance; discarded or ineligible cores still receive no opportunity. The molecular assessment also shows that broader structural coverage continues to include repeated heterocycle growth, tiny fragments, reactive nitrogen-halogen/peroxide groups and strained fused rings. Murcko-core coverage alone does not resolve those quality limitations. Passive comparisons supply probabilities and parent identities, with no scores for alternate offspring or an alternate search trajectory.

nodes.hypothesis: Maintain independent task-local molecular graph walks, generate de novo atom or bond edits from each current working state, accept nondecreasing observed scores and accept decreases with probability exp((new_score-current_score)/T), and cool T as accepted feedback accumulates while preserving a separate best-observed archive.
nodes.finding:
This is the weakest of the thirteen roots at 0.233. It reached 0.558 on deco_hop and 0.382 on zaleplon_mpo but collapsed to 0.045 on drd2_docking and 0.014 on sitagliptin_mpo, where the median score across all 290 proposals was zero. Every mechanism check was exact: the recomputed cooling schedule agreed with all 145 proposal temperatures and all 1,450 stored proposal temperatures, the Metropolis decision reproduced 1,450 times out of 1,450 including the logged uniform variates, 557 downhill moves were accepted and 546 of them were genuinely reused as the source of a later proposal, and the best archive matched an independent cumulative maximum at all 1,600 checkpoints.

This node isolates the round's most important lesson. The search algorithm is provably correct and the search still failed, so what separates the field is not the optimizer but the proposal distribution it draws from. Aromatic content here is 50 to 67 percent against 87 to 100 percent for every root above 0.4, and the graph edits repeatedly produce aromatic phosphorus rings and hypervalent centres that are not real chemistry. Any future work on this lineage belongs in the edit operator set, not in the acceptance rule or the cooling schedule. One seed only, and its deco_hop result shows the walk does work where the initial molecules are already close.

nodes.hypothesis: Combine the exact optional two-cut ring-segment crossover of n-870ed6964d46 with removal of post-crossover finishing on code Parent n-62daf219c70a: set only post_crossover_mutation_probability from 0.35 to 0.0 while retaining its existing random draw after every successful ordinary or ring-mode crossover.
nodes.finding:
All 35,061 successful crossovers retained their original gate draw and skipped finishing; 12,487 draws fell below the former 35% threshold. Ring mode made 5,283 valid two-attachment products. All 169 evaluated noncopy descendants retained the new typed cycle and both selected component patterns, versus 167 of 179 and 151 of 179 in the ring-only treatment. The evaluated noncopy count nevertheless fell from 179 to 169. All 161 nonterminal ring births entered the next model fit, 103 later bred, 41 beat their best parent and 12 improved the incumbent. Eight terminal births were censored; nine task/seed cells evaluated no ring descendant.

The complete four-condition comparison gives a mean interaction of +0.047285, with seed interactions -0.004750, +0.009258 and +0.137346 (population SD 0.063939). Removing finishing improves the ring-only mean by +0.011042, while removing it without ring mode lowers the mean by -0.036243. This is a heterogeneous interaction: ten task/seed interactions are positive, three negative and two unchanged. The joint mean remains 0.561665 versus the Anchor’s 0.595670, a loss of -0.034004 against the required +0.002 gain. Six endpoints improve and nine decline; seed macro changes are -0.078161, +0.010125 and -0.033978. Seed population SD falls from 0.026593 to 0.010338 around the lower mean.

Finishing is a real conditional boundary for this exact construction: the four matched conditions show that its total effect changes when ring mode is present. Correct construction, intact evaluated rings and later breeding rule out a globally broken delivery mechanism, but they do not restore the required endpoint performance. The apparent benefit is concentrated in seed 2, especially docking, and the ring-without-finishing contrast itself is negative in two of three seed macros. Those shared controls are dependent evidence, so the positive mean interaction does not establish a reliable general benefit or independent component replication.

Structural preservation alone is insufficient as an explanation. All three median-2 endpoints improve despite no evaluated ring-mode descendant, and one zaleplon gain occurs with no selected ring construction at all. Eligible mode draws, unselected pool competitors and changed adaptive histories can still change those searches. The joint run produces more local best-parent wins overall (768 versus 629), but mean generating-parent score falls from 0.470456 to 0.403872, mean offspring score from 0.385256 to 0.341961, and the average positive incumbent step from 0.022510 to 0.017312. That separates frequent small local gains from stronger final search.

The chemistry further limits the claim. Ring-rich aromatic and nitrogen/carbonyl families coexist with reactive attachments, difficult bridges or small-ring unsaturation and unresolved stereochemistry. Distinct typed and generic cores fall even as ring-only graph diversity rises; nearby high-scoring conventional examples show that the questionable attachments are not universally needed. Preserving a typed cycle therefore proves neither useful geometry nor feasible synthesis. The present evidence answers the fixed joint contribution question and rejects its separate performance prediction. Which preserved products, lost finishing products, random-stream changes or later feedback paths explain the interaction remains open; no unselected alternative received a score, and no chemical mediation claim follows.

nodes.hypothesis: Modify only the allocation residual output law on sulfur-gated Parent n-1744a1494180: retain the exact original dot-product count-Tanimoto raw mean mu_DP and replace its standardized latent conditional residual covariance C_DP with C_E from the fixed kernel K_E=exp(T_DP-1). Actual draws are mu_DP[None,:] + score_scale * (Z @ chol(C_E + active_jitter*I).T), using the one original batch-by-pool standard-normal array Z and inherited sequential masks/first-index ties. Active marginal SD is score_scale*sqrt(clamp_min(diag(C_E),0)); original means and truthful exponential SDs reach emission and next-fit probe diagnostics. This is one hybrid Gaussian allocation law replacing residual variance and dependence together, not a correlation-only change or the posterior of a single GP kernel.
nodes.finding:
All 15 task/seed runs completed with 300 observations each. Across 435 decision pools, the residual covariance and sample values changed while the original predictive mean stayed intact; 318 selected sets and 326 orders changed, with 626 strict original-law disagreements under the actual masks. All 4,350 offspring joined real prelabel predictions, feedback and accepted archives; 4,200 later reached another fit/probe and 150 final-batch observations were censored. Original-mean ranking/MSE on those same labels remained unchanged. On their different actual streams, Child pair accuracy was 0.69951 versus Parent 0.70955, mean batch Spearman 0.50187 versus 0.52551, and MSE 0.009780 versus 0.011213. The passive exponential mean scored better on the Child labeled stream (accuracy 0.70623, MSE 0.008191); it supplied no active means or extra rewards. Parent beats rose from 648 to 659, sequential incumbent events from 255 to 262, and new productive typed/generic cores from 262/163 to 294/197. But absolute offspring means fell from 0.372050 to 0.370888, best generating-parent means from 0.455304 to 0.445316, and summed incumbent gain from 5.819415 to 5.373764. Productive-source descendant edges fell from 485 to 477 and their average score from 0.360034 to 0.348999. Final macro score was 0.566743 versus 0.596453: paired gain -0.029710 against the required +0.002. Seven task/seed endpoints improved and eight worsened. Seed gains were -0.083275, +0.020415 and -0.026271; Child population dispersion was 0.011974 versus 0.033970. All positive/adverse endpoints and AUC results are retained.

The residual substitution was exposed strongly enough to test the route: its loss cannot be explained by an unchanged allocator, an incorrect mean path, missing feedback or a timeout. This narrows the uncertainty: more local wins and genuinely new productive cores can arise from lower-quality sources and still yield smaller total progress and worse endpoints. Later use did not repair that problem. All 2,519 positively supported Child sources were distinguished from 1,681 nonterminal sources without support; 52 supported sources were never drawn, and the 150 terminal records had no later opportunity. These are opportunity and use observations, not independent ancestral credit. The molecular assessment finds diverse ring-rich families rather than global scaffold collapse, but sulfur-halogen incidence fell from 93 to 8 while nitrogen-halogen incidence rose from 786 to 938, oxygen-halogen from 217 to 262 and carbon allenes from 11 to 148. Questionable attachments, difficult closures and unspecified stereochemistry persist among high scores. Those associations help explain why novelty and a narrow sulfur admission gate cannot certify chemical quality; they do not prove chemical mediation of the endpoint loss. The exact residual route ends under its registered rule. The passive exponential-mean diagnostic does not license choosing a post-result hybrid. The old full exponential experiment used an ungated Parent, so this test and its complementary sibling do not establish a current-Parent factorial interaction, component additivity or transfer. Current Parent composition remains awaiting catalog review, and broader foundation, constituent, joint-interaction, chemical-mediation, partial-lineage-composition and full-history gaps remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace only the shared bounded GraphOperators.mutate neighborhood with a STONED-inspired randomized-serialization single-token SELFIES operation: one fresh session-RNG atom permutation of the current input graph, identity-preserving isomeric Kekule SMILES, strict SELFIES 2.2.0 encoding under its default semantic constraints, then a uniform insertion/deletion/replacement at a uniform eligible token position, using the complete sorted default semantic robust alphabet and excluding same-token replacement. Decode the edited string exactly once and use the exact inherited checked_molecule/max_atoms result. Representation failures and invalid/empty/oversize products spend one of the existing twelve internal attempts; valid graph no-ops remain valid returns and final novelty/admission decides them. All ordinary requested calls, higher-floor escalation, optional crossover finishing, original crossover construction, scored-parent references, sulfur/identity gates, archive/survival and count-GP allocation remain intact. The hypothesized path is changed graph reachability to larger absolute useful accepted gains and productive core descendants, potentially raising the complete endpoint mean.
nodes.finding:
The grammar executed and delivered changed molecules through both ordinary mutation and crossover finishing: 2,888 accepted offspring contained a successful SELFIES call, and 2,866 had an effective graph change. All 15 sessions completed their 300 observations, and every admitted pool and final suggestion remained compliant. New typed cores rose from 1,820 to 2,422, but strict wins over the original scored parents fell from 648 to 487. The sum of positive parent margins fell from 17.251535 to 10.324590, and total sequential incumbent gain fell from 5.819415 to 3.906773. Productive new typed cores had a larger unique accepted-descendant union, yet those descendants added less incumbent gain: 3.438632 versus 4.900088. The complete endpoint mean fell from 0.596453 to 0.468944, a paired loss of 0.127509. All three seed macros and 13 of 15 task endpoints declined, contradicting the required +0.002 gain. The two improving endpoints remain in the result.

Broader graph reachability and real breeding reuse did not produce stronger useful alternatives in this setting. A single token could remove more than one hundred atoms; ordinary-call Morgan similarity fell from 0.703 to 0.472. The original predictor remained prospective and mathematically unchanged, and its MSE on accepted labels and within-batch ordering improved while absolute molecular utility fell. Correct construction and predictor fidelity are established; the adverse contrast therefore concerns the new neighborhood and its ensuing adaptive history. The Molecular assessment suggests disrupted functional-group relationships, large repeated assemblies and electronically incomplete charged or radical-bearing output as plausible explanations. Conventional high scoring families also survive, so these chemistry observations do not identify a single cause or justify a blanket chemical rule. More cores and descendants are insufficient evidence of productive exploration. The fixed recipe now has a complete exposed negative answer; the separate effects of serialization, token operations and ensuing chemistry remain unresolved, and no transfer or tuning result follows.

nodes.hypothesis: Generate neural proposals ancestrally from the normalized geometric mean of the adapted-policy and frozen-prior next-token distributions at each shared generated prefix, with equal fixed exponents and unchanged accepted-score learning.
nodes.finding:
The intended sampling mechanism activated. Across 12,000 raw neural sequences and 579,478 active token prefixes, the recorded behavior distribution differed from the adapted policy. On those same prefixes, mean KL divergence to the frozen prior fell from 0.182477 for the adapted-policy endpoint to 0.040980 for behavior; mean behavior/policy L1 distance was 0.144892. Every raw sequence had lower average behavior-to-prior divergence. All 150 saved audit prefixes reconstruct the registered geometric midpoint. Valid-novel raw yield rose from 7,991/12,000 (66.59%) to 10,319/12,000 (85.99%), improving in all three seeds and all five tasks. Invalid draws fell from 3,807 to 1,680, unterminated draws from 37 to zero and duplicates from 165 to one. However, mean accepted neural score fell from 0.204941 to 0.158382. Among 1,350 later neural emissions, exact ring-core overlap with previously trained graph molecules fell from 53 to 39. The three-seed mean final-best score was 0.542371 versus the parent's 0.550198, a paired change of -0.007826; population standard deviations were 0.030347 and 0.021738. Paired macro changes were +0.009185, -0.078386 and +0.045722. Task-mean changes were -0.020870 for zaleplon, -0.052561 for scaffold hopping, -0.012984 for DRD2, -0.004175 for median similarity and +0.051459 for sitagliptin. Every task completed all 300 evaluations.

Direct reference anchoring can substantially improve syntactic and novelty yield at generated prefixes while attenuating useful accepted-score adaptation. The effect was strongest after the first adapted-policy batch: later valid-novel yield rose from 64.00% to 85.42%, while later accepted neural mean score fell from 0.211885 to 0.160124. Graph feedback continued to train the policy: all 6,480 nonterminal graph-bearing replay steps had nonzero graph-only gradients, and exact accepted graph log likelihood increased by 0.180643 on average per training exposure. The weaker downstream family overlap and scores therefore occurred despite active graph learning. Ring-core overlap is a descriptive connection, not proof of causal or functional transfer. The extra raw yield did not expand the evaluated neural stream under this sampler. Both runs emitted exactly 1,500 neural molecules from 150 calls and needed no additional sampling call. The valid surplus discarded after filling a batch increased from 6,491 to 8,819. Mean active sequence length shortened from 59.409 to 48.290 draws including EOS, but measured neural-phase generation time rose from 14.608 to 27.896 seconds across the runs, including diagnostic overhead. This narrows the result: improved parser/novelty yield alone was not a limiting resource for these full batches. The supplied chemistry assessment describes broad ring-rich output with ordinary medicinal motifs alongside reactive bonds, unusual heteroatom bonding, uncontrolled growth and absent stereochemical specification. Those combined neural/graph outputs do not establish that the extra unscored valid draws preserve useful functional context. The experiment supports the conditional distribution effect and higher raw yield, while leaving useful molecular transfer and search advantage unsupported. It does not show that the adapted weights stayed closer to the prior; the KL comparison holds the generated prefix fixed and compares two sampling distributions at that prefix.

nodes.hypothesis: Extend each valid unselected fresh final proposal to exactly one later suggestion by appending the immediately preceding fresh pool's surviving unselected records after a fully generated current fresh pool, then apply the unchanged current accepted-only correlated posterior selector to that ordered union.
nodes.finding:
The lifetime mechanism ran with full fresh generation intact: all 435 decisions first produced 160 fresh proposals. Of 62,105 admitted deferred occurrences, every prediction changed after ten new real labels and 1,315 were evaluated. They produced 46 incumbent improvements; 593 later became breeders, and 2,797 accepted molecules had a delayed ancestor. Yet the complete mean final Top-1 fell from 0.595670 to 0.548956, a paired change of -0.046714 against the required +0.002 gain. All three seed averages were lower; nine of fifteen task/seed endpoints fell and six improved. The largest task-mean losses were sitagliptin_mpo (-0.147107) and deco_hop (-0.080214), while median_2 improved by 0.005534. Seed dispersion decreased from 0.026593 to 0.012479, around a lower mean. All formal evaluations completed within the unchanged budget and limits.

The result rules out missing exposure, failed revaluation and curtailed fresh output as explanations for the failed endpoint prediction. Useful delayed molecules and extensive descendant ancestry were insufficient to improve the full objective: most delayed evaluations still lost to their original best parent, and one task/seed had no delayed incumbent gain. The matched contrast rejects this fixed one-round lifetime rule under the tested composition; it does not isolate the cost of deferred competition from wider joint draws and the later adaptive trajectories. The passive fresh-only choices have no separately observed outcomes. The chemistry assessment likewise found more distinct core graphs without consistently better leading families: aromatic heterocycles and aryl amines remained prominent, and the strongest Parent arrangements were not reproduced in the tasks with the largest losses. Reactive local bonds, difficult ring geometry and undefined stereochemistry persist alongside more conventional high-scoring examples. Graph diversity and ancestor reachability therefore cannot stand in for reliable endpoint progress or plausible independent chemistry.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove two-parent connected-fragment crossover from fresh-pool production, routing every proposal through the inherited single-parent local-mutation walk while retaining the count-based posterior and correlated batch allocation.
nodes.finding:
Crossover disappears from every one of 73,611 breeding attempts, even though a distinct eligible partner was available each time. The Parent used crossover on 34,334 attempts and evaluated 1,492 crossover offspring. The retained one-parent walks, all seven ordinary mutation families, accepted feedback and correlated posterior selection continue to operate. All three seeds complete. Mean final score falls from 0.595670 to 0.540732, a paired loss of 0.054937 against the registered 0.002 material-loss threshold. Seed losses are 0.112917, 0.004694 and 0.047200. Twelve of fifteen task-seed endpoints fall; median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo improve on seed 1, and zaleplon_mpo improves on seed 2. Population dispersion across seed macros falls from 0.026593 to 0.019996, so the lower dispersion accompanies lower scores. Strict local parent beats nevertheless rise from 629 to 726 and incumbent gains from 258 to 282; those local counts do not predict the endpoint result.

This complete isolated removal supports a positive contribution of connected-fragment crossover in the current exchange-free search composition. That conclusion concerns the whole adaptive rerouting experiment, including changed ancestors and proposal histories; it does not assign value to an individual fragment or recombinant. A simple diversity-collapse explanation is inadequate: typed emitted cores increase from 1,851 to 1,924 while generic cores decrease from 1,118 to 1,009, and every Child emission retains a ring. Mean molecular size increases even though the extreme size range narrows. Molecular evidence likewise shows rich annulated amide, amine and heterocyclic families, with high-scoring conventional alternatives and persistent reactive bonds, difficult geometry and unspecified stereochemistry. More local wins or more typed cores therefore cannot substitute for the complete endpoint comparison or establish chemical feasibility. Which useful arrangements crossover helps search reach, and how that benefit interacts with the retained posterior and mutation continuation, remain open.

nodes.hypothesis: Resolve exact ties at the maximum accepted batch score by choosing the candidate with the fewest heavy atoms, then the lexicographically smallest canonical identity, while leaving every non-tied accepted maximum and the independent best archive unchanged.
nodes.finding:
Six of 28 exact maximum-score ties selected a different molecule, all on deco_hop plateaus in two seeds. Every changed choice preserved the accepted maximum score and used one or two fewer heavy atoms than the lexical winner, saving ten atoms across those decisions. Three choices kept the source size and three reduced it by one atom. All 407 unique maxima retained the same choice on the same accepted batch, and the identity, archive and transition audits passed. Descendants exceeded the compact selected size after five of the six changes; the remaining case finished at that size after five further steps. Later archive improvements occurred, but the complete three-seed macro mean fell from 0.521759 to 0.520655, a paired loss of 0.001104 against the required gain of 0.002. Both affected seeds declined; all four other tasks and the third seed retained exactly the parent's molecule/score sequences.

Equal immediate scores do not make tied molecules equivalent starting points for the remaining search. The rule reached smaller real states and preserved the independent archive, so the missing score benefit cannot be explained by a tie implementation failure or an immediate sacrifice in accepted score. The two affected walks ended smaller than their parents yet found lower best scores, narrowing the claim: this size preference controls some neutral growth, but has not identified better future neighborhoods. The chemistry assessment reinforces the distinction between atom count and useful simplification: deco_hop proposals had slightly fewer atoms on average but greater molecular mass and more nitrogen-halogen bonds, while unusual sulfur chemistry persisted. A compact winner can also be a bond change or element substitution. Local chemical organization or neighborhood quality therefore remains a more informative open question than size alone. Six interventions in two overlapping walks do not isolate the contribution of each choice, and the sparse activation does not establish how the rule would behave on other tasks.

nodes.hypothesis: Search around scored task-local molecules in an injective SELFIES SeqFlow latent space, adapt the flow to high-scoring observations, and use a latent GP with Thompson sampling to select fresh trust-region proposals whose perturbed token blocks are chosen from estimated sequence-level PMI before exact inverse-flow decoding.
nodes.finding:
The node is recorded buggy with no macro score, and its mechanism is refuted. Three objectives completed their full 290 proposals, but drd2_docking stopped at 140 accepted molecules and median_2 at 230, in both cases when a flow adaptation aborted. Of 129 adaptation attempts only 127 completed. The components that did run checked out: corpus pretraining moved held-out token loss from 15.283 to -3.877, exact left-inverse decoding held with a maximum error of 7.7e-07 at the selected checkpoint, all 840 pointwise mutual information estimates were nondegenerate, and every one of the 124 completed batches emitted exactly the announced ten valid novel molecules.

The failure is not in the idea but in adapting the flow while a session is live. Re-encoding every observation after each adaptation is what makes the latent geometry stay useful, and it is also what puts a failure-prone training step inside the oracle loop, where an abort costs the remaining budget on that objective. The partial results that did land are suggestive, with 0.652 on drd2_docking from only 140 calls, so the approach is not obviously weak. The molecules also show a distinct problem: perturbing token blocks in a SELFIES-based latent produces boron, phosphorus and cumulated-double-bond structures at very high rates. A repair should move adaptation to a batch boundary with a guarded fallback before this lineage is judged on score.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace the active accepted-only count-GP learner and Gaussian function distribution jointly with 128 fixed bootstrapped CART response trees on unchanged Morgan counts, allocating each batch position by the maximum of one uniformly sampled tree function with replacement and original-index exact ties.
nodes.finding:
All 435 accepted-archive refits and all 55,680 native tree structures reproduced. Every pool contained 128 distinct functions with 7 to 47 distinct first maximizers, and all 435 selected sets differed from both ensemble-mean and generation-order controls. Selection still relied heavily on pool order: 4,092 of 4,350 sampled-function maxima were exact ties. One unselected tree was constant; no entire batch lacked functional exposure. Real feedback remained intact, with 581 parent wins and 252 incumbent advances, compared with 629 and 258 for the Parent.

The complete three-seed mean fell from 0.595670 to 0.534693, a paired loss of 0.060977 against the required gain of 0.002. Seed changes were −0.082304, +0.000169 and −0.100795. Five task/seed endpoints improved: deco_hop seeds 1 and 2, drd2 seed 1, sitagliptin seed 1 and zaleplon seed 2. Ten declined; all five task means and all three median_2 endpoints were lower. The implemented mechanism is confirmed and its endpoint-benefit prediction is falsified.

Distinct fitted functions and changed evaluation choices were not sufficient for endpoint benefit. Selected-stream mean squared error improved from 0.012718 to 0.010939, while ordering correlation fell from 0.5322 to 0.4474. Every median_2 error improved even though all its endpoints declined. These are different adaptive evaluation streams, so neither the lower error nor the empirical tree spread establishes calibration or explains the total loss. Exact ties, leaf-average support and later search history remain possible contributors whose individual effects were not isolated.

The inherited inputs still merge some distinct molecules: nineteen current alias pairs were observed, but only one pair had both members scored, at an equal value. Trees additionally give equal predictions to many unequal count vectors. Neither representation aliases nor shared leaves prove chemical identity or independent scaffold coverage. Conventional compact indole amides, carbon-bound halogens and available amines coexist with giant linked-ring structures, reactive bonds and difficult bridges. Useful conventional counterexamples rule out a universal need for those liabilities; they do not establish a chemical cause of the score loss.

This result concerns the joint fixed learner and sampled-function law. It does not reverse the useful GP boundary or its conditional component findings, and it does not identify separate effects of trees, bootstrapping, ties or uncertainty. The large runtime spread is preserved: all replicas completed under identical resources, with much of the observed elapsed variation in deco_hop oracle time. Changed molecules and nested instrumentation prevent an isolated learner-speed or chemistry attribution.

nodes.hypothesis: After each complete inherited ordinary single-parent mutation chain, offer its original final product first and then its proper successful graph snapshots in reverse chronological order to the same bounded novel-candidate pool, without shortening or extending the chain.
nodes.finding:
The full inherited mutation chains ran, and 7,287 proper intermediate products entered the fixed pools. Of 461 evaluated prefixes, 78 beat their generating parent, 353 lost and 30 tied; 29 advanced the incumbent. After feedback, 370 survived their batch and 294 later bred in 10,630 actual parent draws. All 435 pools filled. Multiple admissions reduced independent generation attempts from 75,961 to 67,373, without shortening any completed chain. All three matched replicas completed. Mean final score fell from 0.595670 to 0.554740, a paired loss of 0.040930 against the required gain of 0.002. Seed changes were −0.089537, +0.003553 and −0.036805. Four task/seed endpoints improved—zaleplon seed 0, drd2 and sitagliptin seed 1, and median_2 seed 2—while eleven declined. The mechanism is confirmed and its endpoint-benefit prediction is falsified.

Making earlier products visible can expose useful molecules without improving the overall search. Among 49 same-attempt pairs where both prefix and final were actually scored, prefixes won 34, lost ten and tied five. These selected, dependent comparisons do not describe all intermediates. The only prefix that first attained a session endpoint was a zaleplon product whose original final remained unscored; that session still finished below its matched Parent. Across the whole Child, parent wins rose from 629 to 722 and incumbent advances from 258 to 306, yet the complete endpoint mean declined. The retained GP also had lower error on its changed evaluated stream, which cannot establish a better model or explain the loss.

The result applies to this one final-first/reverse-prefix collection rule. Prefix occupancy, fewer independent attempts and later adaptive histories changed together, so their separate effects remain unresolved. It does not reverse the earlier positive contribution of retaining ordinary continuation or justify assuming shallower products are better. Chemical counterexamples reinforce that boundary: a higher-scoring prefix retains an acyl fluoride, while another oxygen-ring prefix loses substantially to its sulfur-ring final. Conventional indole amides and useful aryl amines coexist with reactive bonds, excessive elaboration, difficult rings and unspecified stereochemistry. Extra path coverage did not establish chemical feasibility or independent scaffold coverage. Higher-floor recovery and mutation-call exhaustion were tested only in isolated controls, not naturally exercised here.

nodes.hypothesis: Gate two-cut graph crossover by reciprocal equality of the retained and opposite discarded endpoint contexts, preserving the Parent fragment draws and routing mismatches through its existing mutation fallback.
nodes.finding:
The gate rejected 18,963 otherwise valid joins, including 18,158 that were also novel and encodable. Every one of the 847 surviving applicable joins satisfied both independently reconstructed endpoint matches. The channel remained usable, but barely: only two changed pure crossovers reached evaluation, alongside 27 crossovers followed by mutation. Crossover evaluations fell from 1,133 to 29, and their best-parent beats fell from 121 to two. Overall graph yield improved from 452/2,850 to 541/2,710 best-parent beats; on the same observed batch prefixes, the Parent had 437/2,710. All 271 reached graph batches were full, and all 143 reserved first descendants had real current policy ancestry. However, a feedback identity error stopped one task at 90 of 300 evaluations, so the panel used 4,290 of 4,500 calls and has no complete three-seed score. The two completed seed macro scores rose from 0.542383 to 0.565620 and from 0.579854 to 0.586448. Across complete three-seed task endpoints, sitagliptin rose by 0.163068 and deco_hop by 0.010448, while median_2 fell by 0.020074 and drd2 by 0.002229. Zaleplon fell by 0.006004 over the two completed seeds.

Exact local attachment matching can suppress genuinely available mismatched grafts while preserving a small usable crossover channel. Its dominant effect here was to replace crossover with first-parent mutation: 23 of the 27 later-mutated crossover emissions had reproduced a parent before mutation, and only six evaluated emissions had a changed immediate recombination product. Better overall graph yield therefore does not establish better recombination. Mutation work rose from about 149 to 192 attempts per graph request, and scaffold variety within individual task/seed pools narrowed even though every pool filled. The rule also preserves unusual chemistry already accepted in a source: both pure crossover emissions retained N–F bonds, and the broader output still contained N–O and N–N environments and unspecified stereochemistry. The strong sitagliptin score increase cannot be read as improved synthetic quality. The completion failure is separately explained by an inherited molecule reader alternating between two aromatic SMILES representations after a protected ring-closing mutation; it does not erase the measured gate activation. Full three-seed utility and a useful contribution from compatible recombination remain unresolved.

nodes.hypothesis: Remove the per-sign reservation from bounded inverse-motif installation: select up to the inherited four changed motifs by the Parent's global descending absolute occurrence-change and canonical-motif rank without sign quotas, preserving inherited insertion order on coincident selections and retaining the same-transition bidirectional veto and memory lifecycle.
nodes.finding:
The removal executed exactly and changed 116 of 420 memory installations that could affect later proposals. Most still retained both signs: 414 of 420, while total selected motif-change magnitude increased by only one count. On the Child’s recorded history, restoring balanced selection would change twelve gate decisions: ten candidates were newly admitted by the removal and two were newly vetoed. This reached actual scored allocation and selected states. Eight of fifteen task/seed trajectories changed; all fifteen finished. The three-seed mean final Top-1 score fell from 0.521759 to 0.509908, a paired loss of 0.011851 that exceeds the allowed 0.002 decline. Seed effects were +0.009516, -0.041309 and -0.003760. Sitagliptin supplied the largest loss, especially seed 1 at -0.195597, and DRD2 also declined; zaleplon improved. Mean recorded AUC fell from 0.393354 to 0.391556. The mechanism is confirmed, and the non-inferiority prediction is rejected.

Keeping both signs available is not enough to preserve the contribution of balanced memory allocation. Which motif representatives inherit each transition’s provenance matters even when capacity, magnitude ranking, veto logic and memory lifetime stay fixed. Ten relaxed admissions produced only one source improvement, one tie and eight losses, with no immediate archive gains; most changed the batch cutoff without becoming the next state. Conversely, one added veto enabled an oxygen-deletion refill that did improve the zaleplon archive. These opposing local effects show why fewer vetoes cannot stand in for better search. The loss supports retaining the quota in the developed method on this panel, while leaving the responsible individual replacements unresolved: ten conditional comparison batches lack a tenth recorded member, and passive memories do not define independently evolved walks or scores. Chemistry remained in the same aromatic/carbonyl, aryl-amine and sulfur-cage families, with nearly unchanged size and persistent reactive heteroatom bonds and unspecified stereochemistry. The observed score tradeoff therefore does not establish improved chemical feasibility.

nodes.hypothesis: Veto a valid novel neighbor only when its signed motif changes match every currently live inverse restriction of at least one selected-transition provenance group and that complete group contains both inverse signs, replacing the Parent's one-match-per-sign criterion without changing memory credit or lifecycle.
nodes.finding:
On the Child's actual source states and live memory tables, the inherited rule would veto 178 fresh draws; the complete-signature rule vetoed 65 and admitted the other 113. Every new admission was evaluated, affecting 96 batches across all fifteen task sessions, and twenty became next states. Fifteen improved on their source, five tied and 93 worsened it; five produced immediate archive gains. Complete signatures still vetoed 63 distinct fresh molecular identities, including a two-attribute group left after overlap replacement. Memory credit, four-step tenure and overlap handling were preserved. All budgets and batches completed, using 5209 generation attempts versus the Parent's 5303. The three-seed macro mean fell from 0.521759 to 0.482572, a paired change of -0.039187 against the required +0.002. All three seed means declined. Four task means fell; median_2 rose by 0.002696. The largest task-mean losses were sitagliptin (-0.104268) and DRD2 (-0.075446). Across all accepted proposals, source improvements fell from 468 to 436, and strict archive improvements changed from 238 to 237 while their total magnitude fell from 4.699005 to 4.111202.

Incomplete motif matches do exclude some useful variations: newly admitted methyl addition, ring opening and aryl substitution produced real archive gains. A newly admitted phenol-oxygen deletion was selected despite a score loss, then a newly admitted hydroxymethyl addition in the next batch produced the strongest observed DRD2 molecule. Those concrete successes did not rescue the overall score claim. The checks rule out an unexercised predicate, missing feedback, loss of unconditional memory credit, altered expiry or restored historical signatures as explanations for the negative panel result. Requiring full motif coverage reduces exclusions as intended, but this panel shows that greater matching specificity is not sufficient to identify restrictions that can be removed beneficially. Whether the partial-signature vetoes help diversification remains open: once batch membership changes, later source graphs and random-stream consumption change, and ancestry alone cannot assign the final score difference to one admitted edit. The chemistry assessment also finds persistent reactive heteroatom bonds, unusual sulfur environments, difficult ring geometry and absent stereochemical assignments alongside recognizable aromatic/carbonyl and amine families. The stronger individual molecules therefore do not establish improved chemical feasibility or broader useful scaffold coverage.

nodes.hypothesis: Freeze the active count-Tanimoto GP training dataset to immutable copies of the original usable initial accepted archive in its original order for every inherited fit, jointly freezing its empirical label normalization while retaining full real-archive feedback for live graph breeding and the original correlated posterior allocation on fresh pools.
nodes.finding:
All 435 GP fits keep the same ten initial accepted molecules, raw labels and normalization within each task/seed. Across 420 later fits, 4,200 generated observations remain in the real archive but never enter training; the 150 final observations have no later fit opportunity. Predictions for the same previously emitted molecule stay fixed to numerical precision. The selector remains active on every fresh 160-member pool, with nonzero correlated draws. Recursive breeding also remains active: 1,751 accepted offspring later serve as parents in 102,673 draws.

Every first batch matches the Parent. In batch two, the same pool and normal draws produce different evaluated sets after the first excluded feedback; parent and pool histories diverge in batch three. All three replicas complete. Mean final Top-1 falls from 0.595670 to 0.443813, a paired change of -0.151856 against the predicted loss scale of 0.002. Seed changes are -0.181637, -0.118363 and -0.155569. All fifteen endpoints and all five task means decline. The zaleplon result in seed zero nearly matches its Parent, losing only 0.000484, while the largest loss is 0.430456 in docking seed two. Seed dispersion also falls, around the lower mean.

Ongoing conditioning on generated accepted observations adds value beyond an initially fitted predictor in this optimizer, even when real-label survival, recursive breeding and posterior selection remain active. The experiment therefore answers a narrower question than removing the whole selector or freezing the breeding cohort. Training membership, later label information and empirical normalization were held together: their individual effects, and their interaction with survival, remain unassigned. All sitagliptin fits retain the initial scale floor, but this exposure alone does not establish that the floor causes its endpoint losses.

Useful local search persists under the frozen predictor. It produces 580 best-parent wins and 125 incumbent advances, and every endpoint exceeds its initial best. The molecular assessment finds recognizable amide and aromatic-carbonyl families, useful available amines, changed linkers and ring closures. Some lower-scoring Child leaders have more conventional local chemistry than their Parent counterparts; other outputs retain reactive bonds, doubtful ring geometry and unresolved stereochemistry. The loss does not establish absent chemical novelty, require reactive motifs or identify a chemical mediator. Three leaders arrive in the final batch and cannot show later feedback effects.

The lower selected-stream prediction error is measured on different molecules and cannot establish better calibration or replace the endpoint contrast. Likewise, passive full-archive calculations change all 420 later selected sets on the actual Child pools, but do not supply alternative rewards or future histories. This complete exposed result ends the registered initial-cohort control. Shared-Parent sibling experiments and historical repeated trajectories are dependent evidence, so their effects cannot be added or treated as independent replications.

nodes.hypothesis: When forming a crossover's first-parent fragment, sample only pendant single-bond cuts and retain the side containing every source ring atom and its connecting linkers.
nodes.finding:
Across 34,564 informative first-parent fragment calls, the inherited rule would retain the complete source ring/linker core with mean probability 55.968%; the applied pendant-cut rule made that probability one. All 33,626 sanitized protected crossovers preserved the original core atoms and bonds before canonicalization. Protected crossovers reached 28,875 novel pool descendants and 1,714 actual evaluated descendants; 1,587 of those emissions followed an immediate crossover that changed the first parent’s identity. Of 600 evaluated crossover descendants with a later mutation, 224 no longer contained the original typed ring/linker core. One additional unselected immediate-only pool product changed aromatic representation during the inherited canonicalization step. Mean emitted size rose from 33.39 to 40.90 heavy atoms, and 938 attempted products exceeded the unchanged 120-atom limit. The protected crossover cohort had 210/1,714 strict best-parent beats and mean child-minus-best-parent score -0.112347, compared with 172/1,679 and -0.156871 in the Parent’s crossover cohort. All fifteen Child task/seed runs completed. Mean final score fell from 0.544374 to 0.529067, a paired change of -0.015307; all three paired seeds declined (-0.014873, -0.022309, -0.008738). The mean DRD2 change was -0.090254, despite gains on three other tasks.

Physical inheritance of the first parent’s complete ring system worked and reached evaluation, but the full-core restriction did not improve the complete method. The crossover cohort produced more parent-beating descendants while the complete search ended at lower scores, so that local diagnostic is insufficient to establish improved optimization. It rules out failed cutting or lack of exposure to the selector as the explanation for the negative utility result. Keeping every ring can also keep a large or unproductive framework, while the donor adds more structure and useful peripheral functional relationships can still be removed. Optional mutation can then undo the protected structure. The supplied chemistry is consistent with this limit: conventional arylamide and sulfinamide leaders coexist with duplicated frameworks, dense bridges, reactive substituents and unspecified stereochemistry. The next useful distinction is which core and attachment relationships deserve preservation, and when replacement or simplification is beneficial; this result does not establish that all rings should always survive. The observed crossover subgroups differ in parents and later edits, and the changed random-call schedule alters subsequent search history. Neither the subgroup score difference nor molecular size identifies an individual protected cut’s causal value, and unused candidates have no oracle counterfactual labels.

nodes.hypothesis: Select each successful batch by stable descending posterior mean on the existing fresh pool, removing sampled uncertainty from the identity-allocation rule while retaining the learned count-based posterior.
nodes.finding:
All 4,350 successful choices followed the stable highest-mean order, with zero violations. On the same 435 Child pools, the inherited sampled rule would have selected a different set in every batch. Mean-only selection raised average predicted quality from 0.357917 to 0.390251 and reduced original prediction SD from 0.038134 to 0.020556. Mean absolute within-batch posterior correlation rose from 0.054704 to 0.064071, count-fingerprint similarity rose from 0.5810 to 0.8211, and distinct nonempty chemical cores fell from 6.503 to 4.437 per ten molecules. These are comparisons on identical pools and model distributions.

The completed search scored worse. Three-seed final macro mean fell from 0.574344 to 0.533937, a paired change of -0.040407 against the required +0.002. All three macro replicas declined. Task mean changes were -0.104061 for sitagliptin_mpo, -0.043769 for drd2_docking, -0.036782 for zaleplon_mpo, -0.018368 for deco_hop, and +0.000944 for median_2. This occurred despite strict parent-beating offspring increasing from 624 to 707 out of 4,350 and batches improving the incumbent increasing from 182 to 197. Mean accepted batch-best fell from 0.487313 to 0.437676. Selected-stream prediction MSE fell from 0.011269 to 0.004397, while within-batch rank correlation fell from 0.550 to 0.316. Nominal 95% latent intervals covered only 77.24% of Child scores, versus 76.92% for the Parent. All batches were complete and accepted, with no numerical fallback.

This removal experiment supplies negative utility evidence for treating the sampled excursions as wasted evaluations. The learned mean remains informative against its own archive-mean baseline, but concentrating on its highest predictions produced more local improvements along a search that ended lower. Parent-beating yield and lower selected-stream prediction error therefore remain poor substitutes for final search quality. The model itself was frozen: lower SD exposure and lower error describe the selected molecules and their subsequent feedback, not improved uncertainty calibration.

Lost breadth is a plausible explanation to investigate. The chemistry assessment found fewer distinct cores in 14 of 15 paired streams, consistent with the matched-pool coverage loss. It also found persistent unusual bonds, burdensome decorations and unspecified stereochemistry, so more selective allocation did not establish better chemical feasibility. The result narrows the next question to which exploratory choices or independent molecular families help preserve useful search paths. It does not identify a particular discarded molecule as the missing winner: alternate choices have no counterfactual oracle outcomes, and the downstream histories differ. Transfer beyond this Parent and supplied panel remains open.

nodes.hypothesis: Extend the inherited two-parent crossover with an equally weighted two-cut ring-segment mode only when both actual scored parents have eligible isolated nonaromatic-ring descriptors, joining one complete retained component from each parent by two single bonds while preserving the ordinary single-cut route and its no-support random law.
nodes.finding:
Ring mode was selected on 5,498 of 10,982 jointly eligible opportunities. All 5,496 products constructed below the atom limit conserved the selected source components and made the intended two attachments; two selected choices exceeded the inherited atom limit before construction. There were 4,957 immediate products distinct from both parents and 539 parent copies. The route delivered 179 evaluated descendants of nonidentical constructions: 124 pure crossovers and 55 with finishing mutation. Another 11 evaluations gained novelty only by mutating a parent copy. All 174 nonidentical descendants with a later opportunity entered the next model fit, 96 later bred, 35 beat their best generating parent and 15 improved the incumbent. Exposure was uneven: none of the six zaleplon and decoration-hop runs evaluated a ring-mode descendant.

All fifteen Child task runs completed. Mean final Top-1 score fell from 0.595670 to 0.550623, a paired change of -0.045046 against the required +0.002. Seed macro changes were -0.014404, -0.020055 and -0.100680; ten task-seed endpoints declined, two improved and three were unchanged. Seed population SD increased from 0.026593 to 0.045826. The largest losses were docking seed 2 (-0.309828) and sitagliptin seeds 0 and 2 (-0.113615 and -0.189390). Failed construction and a globally blocked evaluation route do not explain this result: the new two-attachment products were built correctly, evaluated and reused. The complete exposed loss therefore supports a negative total contribution from this particular extension under the tested search composition, while leaving the separate evidence for ordinary crossover intact. Greater local win frequency is misleading here because the generating-parent references also became weaker. One positive endpoint even occurred in a run that never selected ring mode; its eligible mode draw changed the subsequent random stream, so that gain cannot be assigned to a new ring product.

The chemistry narrows the remaining limitation. The search now reaches medium and large nitrogen/carbonyl rings, including 72 accepted proposals with rings of at least twelve atoms, yet access to those graphs does not establish useful arrangements or feasible geometry. Finishing mutation also matters: the new typed ring pattern survives in all 124 pure evaluated recombinants but only 43 of the 55 finished ones. Aromatic, amine and carbonyl families remain well represented, alongside reactive bonds, difficult sulfur and small-ring structures, and unspecified stereochemistry. More scaffold identities and fewer molecules in a limited bond-alert screen coexist with lower scores. The unresolved question is which altered ancestors, pool competition and accepted feedback paths produced the endpoint loss; the observed cohorts do not supply scores for unselected alternatives or isolate an individual ring segment’s causal value. This complete failure closes the registered test without a ring-size, mode-weight or donor-preference sweep.

nodes.hypothesis: Modify optional ordinary second/third mutation continuation at saturation floor one by drawing exactly two fresh arms from the same current intermediate and continuing with the valid arm of greatest raw-score posterior mean from the existing suggestion-entry accepted-label count GP, with first-arm exact ties and bounded inherited fallbacks, while retaining the full final-product pool and correlated final selector.

The continuation rule executed 8,640 two-arm decisions. Independently reconstructed predictions confirm 4,266 strict choices of a different second-arm identity; 44 exact ties chose the first arm. Those changed paths delivered 237 distinct evaluated finals. All 230 with another suggestion remaining entered the next model fit, and 120 later served as breeding parents. The audit also retains 110 nonterminal finals with no later use and seven terminal births; one task/seed had six affected accepted finals and no later breeding. Final proposal capacity stayed at 160 products per suggestion. Nevertheless, mean final Top-1 fell from 0.595670 to 0.547587, a paired change of -0.048083 against the required +0.002. All three seed macros and all five task means decreased; four of the 15 individual task/seed cells improved. Macro population SD declined from 0.026593 to 0.017941, but the gain criterion failed.

This result rules out lack of execution, absent evaluated delivery, lost feedback, zero cohort-level recursion and reduced final-pool capacity as explanations for the failure of this fixed rule. The model successfully imposed its preferences without producing better search. Across all accepted offspring, mean raw score fell from 0.385256 to 0.326704 while mean best-generating-parent score fell from 0.470456 to 0.395280. Parent-beating counts rose from 629 to 690 and incumbent-update counts from 258 to 261, yet total incumbent increments fell from 5.807663 to 5.086425. More local wins therefore coexist with weaker sources and less endpoint progress. Selected-stream prediction MSE fell from 0.012718 to 0.007832, but the labels being predicted changed and recorded 1.96-standard-deviation coverage fell from 76.28% to 74.60%; this does not establish better transferable calibration. Chemistry inspection likewise finds both recognizable aromatic amides and amines and persistent questionable bond environments, ring geometries and unresolved stereochemistry. The largest deficits include failure to reproduce a compact high-scoring heterocyclic combination, but neither missing rings/amines nor a specific chemical mediator is established. Most unchosen arms remain unscored, and no alternate continuation future was executed. The evidence supports a negative total contribution of this exact fixed guidance rule under these conditions; it leaves the separate roles of local prediction preferences, extra random draws and later adaptive history unresolved, and does not reverse the value of ordinary continuation itself.

nodes.hypothesis: Replace successful independent-row posterior allocation with greedy incumbent-referenced expected batch improvement over one fixed 128-or-announced-batch-size shared joint posterior panel, using only the best previously accepted raw score and exact smallest-index ties.
nodes.finding:
The allocation mechanism executed and changed real decisions. All 435 frozen incumbents, 128-row posterior panels and 4,350 exact greedy choices passed independent reconstruction. There were 3,681 positive-gain choices and 669 exact-zero choices; 23 complete batches had zero sampled improvement from their first position. Every zero choice followed the registered smallest-index tie rule without a fallback. All 435 selected sets differed from the Parent rule on the same panels. Mean sampled batch-improvement utility rose by 0.005726: 371 batches improved, 64 tied and none declined. Against the unthresholded shared-panel rule, 343 sets changed and mean utility rose by 0.000256, with fifteen contrary losses.

Real progress moved the other way. Average realized batch improvement fell from 0.013351 to 0.011410. Advancing batches rose from 202 to 204 and sequential incumbent updates from 258 to 270, but mean positive batch gain fell from 0.028751 to 0.024331. Mean accepted offspring score also fell, from 0.385256 to 0.351177. All evaluations completed, yet final mean score fell from 0.595670 to 0.539394, a paired change of -0.056276 against the required +0.002. Seed changes were -0.092867, -0.016706 and -0.059254. Nine task-seed endpoints declined and six improved, including all three median-similarity endpoints.

The experiment exposes a failure of the complete incumbent-referenced allocation rule under this Parent: correct positive-improvement targeting and higher sampled utility did not deliver larger real advances. More update events again accompanied smaller increments. The mean realized batch-improvement contrast telescopes to the final-score contrast on these equal-length streams, so those two failures should not be counted as independent endpoint evidence. The result supports a negative contribution from this whole rule under the tested composition. A threshold-only endpoint effect remains unresolved because the current unthresholded comparison has no separately evaluated future trajectory.

Finite-panel zero gain also failed to identify unproductive molecules. Fourteen zero-gain choices beat their frozen real incumbent, eleven made sequential incumbent updates, 205 were later bred and 119 survived to the final populations. Two became session leaders. Every one of those fourteen real wins had no sampled scenario above the incumbent. The chemical report includes a ring-free urea/enamide/thiocarbonyl leader and a distinct aza-dicarbonyl leader in this group. These are concrete limits of the sampled improvement support; they do not establish whether model error, finite tail sampling, myopic selection or later breeding caused the overall loss.

Selected-stream MSE and interval coverage improved while within-batch ordering weakened, but the selected molecules and histories changed. Those diagnostics do not establish repaired uncertainty or improved chemistry. Familiar amines and lactams still coexist with reactive bonds, difficult rings, large assemblies and unspecified stereochemistry. The older unthresholded and antithetic failures retain their exchange-containing Parent conditions, and shared-Parent siblings supply no isolated threshold, additive or joint-component effect. The complete exposed endpoint failure supplies the registered approach-review evidence without authorizing acquisition tuning.

nodes.hypothesis: Refine only the Parent's attachment and ring-closure pheromone keys with fixed, permutation-invariant one-bond neighborhood descriptors so accepted winner reinforcement transfers between matching local neighborhoods instead of all sites sharing the Parent's coarser endpoint description.
nodes.finding:
The intended credit localization happened. Across the five task-specific tables, 3,027 attachment keys and 6,522 ring-closure keys separated previously shared neighborhoods. All 145 online winner updates withheld deposits from other neighborhoods when opportunities existed, totaling 75,964 alternative/update pairs. Every one of 10,719 mixed-neighborhood update probes increased the winner neighborhoods' conditional probability mass. Later construction contained 18,485 selected moves whose conditional probabilities changed and whose exact neighborhoods traced to earlier accepted online winners. The optimization gain was much smaller than the amount of activity. Among accepted ants that reused online credit, 7 of 1,396 beat their pre-batch incumbent, compared with 3 of 1,399 for the Parent; reuse still reached about 96% of accepted ants. All strict incumbent beaters increased from 8 to 12, but three of the new online-reusing docking beaters were steps of at most 0.00000044 along a low score plateau. The single screening seed's mean final Top-1 rose from 0.2523 to 0.2579. The sitagliptin multi-property score rose from 0.0980 to 0.2392, while dopamine-receptor docking fell from 0.1371 to 0.0289 and decoration hopping fell from 0.5534 to 0.5484. The zaleplon and median-molecule scores stayed at 0.3051 and 0.1678. No generated molecule beat the supplied starting incumbent on three of the five objectives. All 1,450 submitted molecules were accepted; one additional local construction repeated a molecule and was replaced before submission.

This experiment separates local credit discrimination from productive molecular search. Different neighborhoods really were being collapsed by the old keys, and the new keys distinguish them without changing the legal chemistry or fixed heuristic weights. Matching neighborhoods also recur often enough to transfer credit across different partial molecules, so the refinement did not eliminate transfer through excessive sparsity. Yet most ants still inherit some online credit, and only 5.84% of the observed split-menu groups carried unequal refined pheromones. More precise keys therefore changed specific decisions without making successful whole molecules common. The chemistry explains why the modest mean gain should not be read as a broadly improved generator. The molecular assessment found a compact acyclic urea behind the strongest score increase, but long unsaturated chains and unconventional ring assemblies still dominate. Mean atom count fell slightly, while ring-closure actions fell sharply and terminations at the 64-atom ceiling became more frequent. In every task the late molecules were larger than the early molecules. Local credit refinement alone did not produce sustained access to compact, organized, functionalized chemistry. The result supports the implementation and shows a descriptive gain on this seed; it does not establish a reliable oracle-score benefit of selective credit. Larger changes in different objectives nearly cancel, some counted gains are near numerical ties, and the same-menu probability comparisons do not score unsubmitted alternatives. Whether broader molecular constraints or a better size and termination prior can make the now-demonstrated local discrimination useful remains open, as does its reliability across seeds.
